parole.testo: From Proto-Finno-Ugric *orpa (“orphan”). Cognates include Finnish orpo, Estonian orb and Erzya уроз (uroz), originally from an Indo-European language (Proto-Indo-European *h₃órbʰos). Compare Sanskrit अर्भ (árbha), Ancient Greek ὀρφανός (orphanós), Armenian որբ (orb). Doublet of rab.  PIE word  *h₃ór
